We will begin by teaching some basics of space flight and hyperspacing. In normal flight, use the direction keys to move your ship. To start training, you will have to travel to a Confederate system, then return here. To do this, access your map by pressing "m" once you have left ConEx. Then, find the system with the red arrow pointing to it. To move toward that system, select a system adjecent to Levo in the direction of the arrow on the map and press OK. Move away from the planet and press "j" to jump. Once you have entered the next system, you can land on the planet, or move to another system adjecent to that one. When you have reached the destination system, <DSY>, marked with the red arrow, land on the correct planet, <DST>, then return to the Flight Academy to complete the mission. Hail Cap'n Twinkie if you need any help. Good luck.
